papers.title: PDA++: Field-Aligned Planning and Scene-Adaptive Insertion in Remote Sensing
papers.title_zh: PDA++：遥感中的场对齐规划与场景自适应插入
papers.reason: 该文提出遥感影像中的环境感知目标插入框架，用于少样本和长尾场景的数据增强，涉及遥感变化检测之外的识别与分割增强，与遥感数据挖掘和多源数据融合有一定关联。
papers.abstract: Remote sensing recognition is often constrained by scarce observations of rare targets and costly annotations, making realistic synthetic augmentation particularly valuable for few-shot and long-tailed scenarios. Object insertion provides an efficient way to increase target diversity while preserving authentic background scenes, but realistic insertion in overhead imagery requires the generated target to adapt coherently to its surrounding environment. To this end, we propose PDA++, a unified environment-aware object insertion framework organized as Plan, Decouple, and Assimilate. Planning determines scene-compatible poses through an affordance field that combines geometric clearance with structure- and scale-aware cues. Decoupling introduces a pose-conditioned background that provides precise spatial guidance together with target-scene context, allowing the reference object to preserve its identity while adapting to the target observation. This construction also naturally provides pixel-level masks for segmentation augmentation. Assimilation further improves local coherence by aligning multi-scale texture distributions through optimal transport. On the optical benchmark, PDA++ achieves a whole-image FID of 6.28 and improves average few-shot recognition mAP50 by 17.69 points, corresponding to a 28.8% relative gain over the real-data baseline. On SAR imagery, it improves ship detection by 4.10 mAP50 points and remains effective under cross-dataset transfer and amorphous-target insertion. Code is available at https://github.com/lisheyu972/PDA_PLUS.
papers.summary_zh: 遥感识别常受稀有目标观测稀缺和标注昂贵的限制，因此逼真的合成增强对少样本和长尾场景尤其有价值。目标插入可在保留真实背景场景的同时高效增加目标多样性，但在俯视影像中实现逼真插入需要生成目标与周围环境协调一致。为此，作者提出PDA++，一个统一的环境感知目标插入框架，组织为规划（Plan）、解耦（Decouple）和同化（Assimilate）。规划通过结合几何间隙与结构和尺度感知线索的可供性场确定场景兼容姿态。解耦引入姿态条件背景，提供精确空间引导和目标-场景上下文，使参考目标在保持身份的同时适应目标观测。该构造还自然提供用于分割增强的像素级掩码。同化通过最优传输对齐多尺度纹理分布，进一步提升局部一致性。在光学基准上，PDA++取得整图FID 6.28，并将平均少样本识别mAP50提升17.69点，相对真实数据基线提升28.8%。在SAR影像上，它将船舶检测提升4.10 mAP50点，并在跨数据集迁移和非定形目标插入下仍然有效。代码见：https://github.com/lisheyu972/PDA_PLUS。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作表明，环境感知的目标插入可通过规划、解耦和同化提升合成样本的真实性与下游识别性能，为遥感少样本和长尾场景的数据增强提供了可迁移思路。

papers.title: Deep Evidential Regression for Sparse Forest Height Estimation from Multimodal Satellite Imagery
papers.title_zh: 基于多模态卫星影像的稀疏森林高度估计深度证据回归
papers.reason: 该文利用Sentinel-1/2多模态卫星影像进行森林高度估计，并引入深度证据回归量化不确定性，属于遥感回归与多源数据融合，与地理空间智能相关。
papers.abstract: Accurate estimation of forest height from satellite imagery is essential for applications such as carbon accounting, biodiversity monitoring, and ecosystem management. While recent deep learning approaches provide accurate predictions, they typically do not quantify predictive uncertainty. This limitation is particularly relevant in geospatial settings characterized by sparse supervision and geographic distribution shift. In this work, we investigate Deep Evidential Regression (DER) for forest height estimation on the TreeUQ benchmark, a large-scale dataset designed for the joint estimation of tree count and average tree height at 10 m resolution, based on Sentinel-1/-2 data as well as tree inventory data over the federal state of Bavaria. To account for the extreme label sparsity of the tree inventory data, we introduce a masked evidential loss for dense geospatial prediction. Using a U-Net architecture with multimodal Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 inputs, the proposed approach jointly predicts tree height and associated uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass. Experimental results show that DER achieves predictive performance comparable to a deterministic U-Net while additionally providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates. These findings demonstrate the potential of evidential learning as an efficient framework for uncertainty-aware forest structure estimation from Earth observation data.
papers.summary_zh: 从卫星影像准确估计森林高度对碳核算、生物多样性监测和生态系统管理至关重要。尽管近期深度学习方法预测准确，但通常不量化预测不确定性，这在地理空间场景中因稀疏监督和地理分布偏移而尤为相关。本文研究深度证据回归（DER）用于森林高度估计，基于TreeUQ基准，该大规模数据集设计用于在10米分辨率下联合估计树木数量和平均树高，使用Sentinel-1/-2数据以及德国巴伐利亚州的树木清查数据。为应对树木清查数据的极端标签稀疏性，作者引入用于密集地理空间预测的掩码证据损失。采用U-Net架构和多模态Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2输入，所提方法在单次前向传播中联合预测树高及相关不确定性估计。实验结果表明，DER达到与确定性U-Net相当的预测性能，同时额外提供良好校准的不确定性估计。这些发现表明证据学习作为从地球观测数据中进行不确定性感知森林结构估计的高效框架的潜力。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究显示，深度证据回归可在不牺牲预测性能的情况下为稀疏监督的森林高度估计提供校准不确定性，提示不确定性量化可增强遥感回归模型在地理分布偏移下的可靠性。

papers.title: Tabular Deep Learning vs Classical Machine Learning for Urban Land Cover Classification
papers.title_zh: 表格深度学习与经典机器学习在城市土地覆盖分类中的对比
papers.reason: 该文直接面向城市土地覆盖分类，使用高分辨率航空影像衍生的表格特征，比较经典机器学习与表格深度学习模型，与城市遥感分类及多源数据挖掘相关，但未涉及城市更新、时空数据挖掘或LLM/多智能体。
papers.abstract: Urban Land Cover (ULC) classification plays a crucial role in urban planning, environmental monitoring, and sustainable development. We study this task using the ULC dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, which includes tabular features derived from high-resolution aerial imagery across nine classes (e.g., roads, trees, grass, water). The dataset presents typical remote sensing challenges, including high dimensionality, heterogeneous features, and class imbalance. In a unified, reproducible pipeline, we benchmark classical machine learning models (e.g., Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost) against Tabular Deep Learning (TDL) models (TabNet, FT-Transformer, TabTransformer, TabSeq, and 1D CNNs). To address class imbalance, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss for TDL models and evaluate performance using accuracy, macro-precision, macro-recall, macro-F1, AUC-ROC, and confusion matrices. Our results show that while tree ensembles remain strong general baselines, TDL models can match or exceed their performance when non-linear interactions are significant and imbalance handling is effective, providing complementary advantages for urban land cover mapping. See code: https://github.com/mtesha/tdl-vs-ml-urbanlandcover
papers.summary_zh: 城市土地覆盖（ULC）分类在城市规划、环境监测和可持续发展中至关重要。本文使用UCI机器学习库中的ULC数据集研究该任务，该数据集包含由高分辨率航空影像衍生的表格特征，涵盖道路、树木、草地、水体等九类。数据集呈现典型遥感挑战，包括高维、异构特征和类别不平衡。在一个统一、可复现的流程中，作者将经典机器学习模型（如逻辑回归、SVM、随机森林、XGBoost、CatBoost）与表格深度学习（TDL）模型（TabNet、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer、TabSeq和1D CNN）进行基准比较。为应对类别不平衡，TDL模型采用加权交叉熵损失，并使用准确率、宏精确率、宏召回率、宏F1、AUC-ROC和混淆矩阵评估性能。结果表明，树集成仍是强通用基线，但当非线性交互显著且不平衡处理有效时，TDL模型可以匹配或超过其性能，为城市土地覆盖制图提供互补优势。代码见：https://github.com/mtesha/tdl-vs-ml-urbanlandcover。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示，在城市土地覆盖分类中，表格深度学习并非普遍优于树集成，其优势依赖于非线性交互的显著性和不平衡处理策略；这为遥感分类模型选择提供了可复现的基准参考。

papers.title: Decoder-Agnostic Token Merging for Vision Transformers: A Systematic Study of G2TM
papers.title_zh: 面向视觉Transformer的解码器无关Token合并：G2TM的系统研究
papers.reason: 该文系统研究视觉Transformer的token合并模块G2TM，跨多种分割框架和解码器评估，属于计算机视觉效率优化，与遥感语义分割有方法上的潜在关联，但未直接涉及地理空间数据。
papers.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance across a range of computer vision tasks, mainly thanks to the self-attention mechanism. However, its complexity, increasing quadratically with the number of tokens, remains the major obstacle to ViT efficiency and deployment at scale. Token merging reduces this cost by aggregating redundant tokens. Yet existing methods are typically evaluated within a single architecture, leaving open whether their effectiveness stems from the merging mechanism itself or from the specific decoder they are paired with. We extend Graph-Guided Token Merging (G2TM), a single module inserted early in a ViT-based network, beyond its original Segmenter setting. We evaluate G2TM across three semantic segmentation frameworks (Segmenter, SETR, EoMT) and three decoder families (Linear, Transformer-, convolution-based), as well as standard ViT image classification. Our results show that G2TM's behavior and accuracy-efficiency trade-off are consistent across every tested architecture for a given backbone size, indicating that its effectiveness is a property of the encoder rather than the decoder. G2TM also generalizes well to image classification, achieving an even smaller degradation in accuracy compared to semantic segmentation. We further find that G2TM's optimal hyperparameters, resulting in a consistent drop in GFLOPs of 22-47% and an increase in throughput by up to 74% for segmentation models on ADE20K dataset, depend primarily on the backbone's pre-training recipe and on the target dataset, rather than on the decoder choice.
papers.summary_zh: 视觉Transformer（ViT）在一系列计算机视觉任务中取得最先进性能，主要归功于自注意力机制。然而，其复杂度随token数量二次增长，仍是ViT效率和规模化部署的主要障碍。Token合并通过聚合冗余token降低这一成本。然而现有方法通常仅在单一架构内评估，无法确定其有效性来自合并机制本身还是所搭配的特定解码器。作者将图引导Token合并（G2TM）——一个插入ViT网络早期的单一模块——扩展到其原始Segmenter设置之外。他们在三种语义分割框架（Segmenter、SETR、EoMT）和三种解码器家族（线性、Transformer、卷积）以及标准ViT图像分类上评估G2TM。结果表明，对于给定骨干网络规模，G2TM的行为和精度-效率权衡在所有测试架构中一致，表明其有效性是编码器属性而非解码器属性。G2TM在图像分类上也泛化良好，相比语义分割精度下降更小。作者进一步发现，G2TM的最优超参数主要取决于骨干网络的预训练方案和目标数据集，而非解码器选择；在ADE20K数据集上，分割模型GFLOPs一致下降22-47%，吞吐量提升最高74%。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究表明，G2TM的有效性主要源于编码器而非解码器，且其最优超参数依赖预训练方案和数据集，为视觉Transformer在分割任务中的高效部署提供了架构无关的实证依据。

papers.title: UniFusion: Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction via Unified Spatio-temporal Depth Alignment
papers.title_zh: UniFusion：通过统一时空深度对齐实现稀疏视图4D重建
papers.reason: 该研究关注动态场景的4D重建，涉及深度估计和时空对齐，与遥感三维重建有一定关联，但主要面向视频领域。
papers.abstract: In this paper, we address the challenging problem of 4D reconstruction from sparse-view videos. This setup usually relies on monocular depth estimation to provide priors for the reconstruction model. A key challenge arises from limited cross-view overlap and temporal variation, making monocular depth predictions inconsistent across views and time. Existing methods align spatial and temporal dimensions in separate stages, requiring foreground segmentation masks while failing to leverage temporal cues for cross-view alignment. Contrary to these methods, we propose a unified spatial-temporal depth alignment framework that jointly resolves cross-view and cross-time inconsistencies without distinguishing foreground/background. Our method represents depth maps across views and time as a set of spatio-temporal neural fields. This representation not only yields fast convergence, but also captures spatio-temporal correlation among depth maps implicitly, without dependence on external segmentation/tracking models. We also propose a multi-view depth-order loss while leveraging the classic scale-and-shift-invariant loss to further improve the final depth quality. The aligned depths initialize and supervise Gaussian splatting models for 4D reconstruction. Experiments on Ego-Exo4D and EgoHuman demonstrate that our improved depth alignment substantially benefits dynamic Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction methods for novel-time/view synthesis and geometry accuracy/consistency.
papers.summary_zh: 提出一种统一的时空深度对齐框架，联合解决跨视角和跨时间的不一致性，无需区分前景/背景。方法将跨视角和时间的深度图表示为时空神经场集合，隐式捕获时空相关性。并提出多视图深度顺序损失，结合尺度和平移不变损失提升深度质量。对齐后的深度用于初始化和监督高斯泼溅模型进行4D重建。在Ego-Exo4D和EgoHuman数据集上验证了有效性。
papers.insight_zh: 将深度图表示为时空神经场并联合对齐，可有效解决稀疏视图视频中单目深度估计不一致的问题，提升动态场景重建质量。
